summary: The note is a fragment of a Wikipedia article on the India–Pakistan cricket rivalry, consisting only of a table of tournament wins. one_line: Tally of India and Pakistan cricket tournament titles across the World Cup, World Twenty20 and Champions Trophy.
key_facts: India has won the Cricket World Cup 2 times, in 1983 and 2011.
Pakistan has won the Cricket World Cup 1 time, in 1992.
India has won the World Twenty20 1 time, in 2007.
Pakistan has won the World Twenty20 1 time, in 2009.
India has won the Champions Trophy 2 times, in 2002 and 2013.
Pakistan has won the Champions Trophy 1 time, in 2017.
The note lists tournament wins only and contains no narrative about the rivalry.
The table is organized in columns for tournament, India and Pakistan, with each cell giving the count and years of titles.
